question: What hyperparameters are explored?

answer.free_form_answer: Dimension size, window size, architecture, algorithm, epochs, hidden dimension size, learning rate, loss function, optimizer algorithm.
Hyperparameters explored were: dimension size, window size, architecture, algorithm and epochs.
evidence: To form the vocabulary, words occurring less than 5 times in the corpora were dropped, stop words removed using the natural language toolkit (NLTK) (BIBREF22) and data pre-processing carried out. Table TABREF2 describes most hyper-parameters explored for each dataset. In all, 80 runs (of about 160 minutes) were conducted for the 15MB Wiki Abstract dataset with 80 serialized models totaling 15.136GB while 80 runs (for over 320 hours) were conducted for the 711MB SW dataset, with 80 serialized models totaling over 145GB. Experiments for all combinations for 300 dimensions were conducted on the 3.9GB training set of the BW corpus and additional runs for other dimensions for the window 8 + skipgram + heirarchical softmax combination to verify the trend of quality of word vectors as dimensions are increased.

title: Word2Vec: Optimal Hyper-Parameters and Their Impact on NLP Downstream Tasks
answer_short: dimension size, training epochs, window size, and vocabulary size
answer_rationale: The hyperparameters explored are explicitly stated in Text 2 (source_id=5), which mentions the scope of the work includes 'dimension size, training epochs, window size and vocabulary size for the training algorithms (hierarchical softmax and negative sampling) of both skipgram and CBoW.' This is further corroborated by Text 1 (source_id=14), which references Table TABREF2 describing these hyperparameters, and Text 4 (source_id=11), which lists dimension size, window size, and vocabulary size as key hyperparameters, aligning with the scope of the study.
